say:1:1360227001:0.text: After the Hypofiends are repelled, the corrupt magic fades away, and everything falls back into place.
say:1:1360227001:0.source_cn: 驱逐魔物后，邪恶的气息消散，一切重归平静。

say:2:1360227002:1.text: After seeing the acolytes off, you explain everything to Temesia and Lucius.
say:2:1360227002:1.source_cn: 你们送走了两位修士，接着，向特弥希娅和卢修斯解释了一切...

say:4:1360227003:1.source_cn: 贝利尔……又是那个可憎的家伙！

say:5:1360227004:1.text: Thanks to the acolytes who've been praying around the clock to secure the seal, Berial's corrupt magic is effectively blocked.
say:5:1360227004:1.source_cn: 幸好看守封印的修士都日夜不停地祈祷着，神圣的气息能隔绝...

say:6:1360227005:1.text: Had Berial managed to possess them or even replace them, the seal would have been in serious danger.
say:6:1360227005:1.source_cn: 如果贝利尔能附到他们身上，甚至取而代之，那封印可就危险了。

say:7:1360227006:1.text: Fortunately, Temesia was sharp enough to notice the problem.
say:7:1360227006:1.source_cn: 幸好特弥希娅足够敏锐地发现了问题。

choice_prompt:8:1360227006.text: Fortunately, Temesia was sharp enough to notice the problem.
choice_prompt:8:1360227006.source_cn: 幸好特弥希娅足够敏锐地发现了问题。

say:9:1360227007:1.text: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.
say:9:1360227007:1.source_cn: 是的，不止是唱歌的那两位，我和卢修斯听到的声音也不一样。
say:9:1360227007:1.male: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.
say:9:1360227007:1.female: You're right. Besides the acolytes' off-key singing, it's strange that Lucius and I heard different things.

say:10:1360227009:1.text: Frankly speaking, I didn't even realize they were out of tune until Temesia pointed it out.
say:10:1360227009:1.source_cn: 事实上，我一开始甚至也没听出走调，是特弥希娅提醒了我以...

say:11:1360227010:1.text: Maybe it's because every time I sing, I can only hear my own loud voice. I rarely pay attention to others.
say:11:1360227010:1.source_cn: 因为我声音很大，基本一唱歌就只能听到自己的声音了，很少...

say:12:1360227011:1.text: Hmm... Could I be possessed? Not likely, right?!
say:12:1360227011:1.source_cn: 嘶……难道是我被附体了？不会吧？！

say:13:1360227012:1.text: We can't get caught up in this vicious cycle of second-guessing, or we'll be playing right into Berial's hands.
say:13:1360227012:1.source_cn: 我和卢修斯不能陷入这种猜疑与质证的循环当中，否则肯定正...

say:14:1360227013:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?
say:14:1360227013:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?
say:14:1360227013:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, is there a way to detect corrupted beings like you just did?

say:16:1360227014:1.text: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
say:16:1360227014:1.source_cn: 顿里尔大人的钟也用了，还能有什么办法呀，主人？
say:16:1360227014:1.male: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
say:16:1360227014:1.female: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?

choice_prompt:17:1360227014.text: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.source_cn: 顿里尔大人的钟也用了，还能有什么办法呀，主人？
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.male: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?
choice_prompt:17:1360227014.female: Besides using Dunlingr's bell, what else can we do, Magister?

say:18:1360227015:1.text: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.
say:18:1360227015:1.source_cn: 一起唱圣歌……吗，虽然和卢修斯一起演唱不算什么愉快的体验。
say:18:1360227015:1.male: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.
say:18:1360227015:1.female: Singing... together? Can't say singing with Lucius is all that enjoyable.

say:19:1360227016:1.text: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.
say:19:1360227016:1.source_cn: 但，总比调子都跑到白山公国的阿塔兰忒强多了。
say:19:1360227016:1.male: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.
say:19:1360227016:1.female: But he's still a much better option than Atalanta. That girl is literally tone-deaf, I'm afraid.

say:20:1360227017:1.text: That doesn't really reassure me, Temesia.
say:20:1360227017:1.source_cn: 我可不觉得你是在夸我，特弥希娅。

say:21:1360227018:1.text: Alright, let's begin! Hope it works...
say:21:1360227018:1.source_cn: 好了，开始吧！希望能有效果……

narration:22:1360228001:0.text: Temesia kicks off the song, and Lucius soon follows with his deep, sonorous voice.
narration:22:1360228001:0.source_cn: 特弥希娅起了个头，卢修斯紧跟着，用响亮的声音加入。

narration:23:1360228002:0.text: The singing is anything but perfect, yet the song gradually fills the air with a sense of purity...
narration:23:1360228002:0.source_cn: 那歌声绝对谈不上多么美妙，但在特弥希娅的引领下，气氛逐...

narration:25:1360228003:0.text: Without warning, a scream shatters the silence as a figure emerges from Temesia's shadow...
narration:25:1360228003:0.source_cn: 紧接着，随着一声大叫，从特弥希娅的影子里滚出来了一个人影——

say:28:1360229001:0.text: Argh! That's so awful! I can't take it anymore!

say:29:1360229002:0.text: What did I do to deserve this torture? It's not like I swallowed your shadows!
say:29:1360229002:0.source_cn: 我都没有直接吞掉你们的影子，你们居然唱这样难听的歌！

say:31:1360229004:1.text: We should be the ones saying that!
say:31:1360229004:1.source_cn: 这话该由我们说才对吧！

say:33:1360227008:1.text: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...
say:33:1360227008:1.source_cn: 是的，卢修斯只听到了走调，而我却听到了扭曲的狂笑声……
say:33:1360227008:1.male: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...
say:33:1360227008:1.female: You're right. While Lucius only heard them singing off-key, I heard them laughing uncontrollably...
